8,350 reviews. 4.8 stars. And you probably walked right past MEO Kitchen.

This Vietnamese spot on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is what locals actually eat. Real pho, proper broken rice, grilled dishes that don't taste like they were made for tourists. Prices sit at $15-30 a person. For food this good, that's nothing.

If your Phu Quoc itinerary is just resort buffets, you're doing it wrong.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
